name: Aoharu no Tsuzuki, Shiteminai? ~Motokano no Musume ni Yuuwaku Sare, Kindan no Nikuyoku ni Oboreyuku...~
original_name: 青春の続き、シてみない？ ～元カノの娘に誘惑され、禁断の肉欲に溺れゆく…～
source:
I, Mashibahara Kumihiko, was assigned as a new teacher at my alma mater this year. On my first day, I saw my ex-girlfriend from my youth. 

More than 20 years have passed since then, but her appearance has not changed. Was it a hallucination? I followed her and put my hand on the classroom door.

There she was, the daughter of my ex-girlfriend ,Doujou Manami. At that time, I had no idea that I would spend my "youth" with her.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt275/apt275.html#link_story]official site[/url]]
